harry_bot.name: Harry (QA sign-off; bot in the mock)

pr_review.notes: Owner approves the version bump PR on GitHub (reviewer TheViper-10) or in Slack. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:246-255 (moment 4) and 18-coordinator-design-decisions.md:6 (review = owner, GitHub TheViper-10, Slack U042GEDM4BB). No second person is listed, so stand_ins is empty.

approve-desktop-qa-latest.notes: Owner's go for the QA publish (for example 'go, that one is a flake'). Gate name is the CircleCI approval job in gh-config.yml:118-121, which publishes to QA through desktop-app-publish-download-page-qa (gh-config.yml:122-126). Approvers: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:267-276 (moment 6); 21-work/B-live.md:153 (qa = U042GEDM4BB).

approve-desktop-prod-alpha.notes: QA sign-off before prod alpha. Gate name is the CircleCI approval job in gh-config.yml:128-131; it only requires the build, so order is Tony's job (gh-config.yml:127). Harry primary, owner stand-in: 18-coordinator-design-decisions.md:6. The sign-off ask is allowed only in the QA thread: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:289-296 (moment 8) and :425 (rule 26). Real release later: Abhay U0ANLN96KNH as primary (18-coordinator-design-decisions.md:6), not in this mock spec.

cancel.notes: Who may say cancel. Any person on this list can cancel at any time. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:314-321 (moment 11) and 21-work/B-live.md:153 (cancel = U042GEDM4BB). No action uses it; it is the responder list for a cancel ask.

bump_pr_open.notes: Version bump PR is open and waiting for the owner's review. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:217-226 (moment 1). Audience default per 28-handoff-work-engine-build.md section 3 D3.

pr_approved.notes: Owner approved the PR on GitHub, often without a Slack mention. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:246-255 (moment 4); 23-work/facts-brief.md:53.

merged.notes: PR merged into the base branch; the CircleCI pipeline starts. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:257-265 (moment 5).

qa_go_requested.notes: Tony reports the Playwright results and asks the owner for the QA go. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:267-276 (moment 6); 23-work/facts-brief.md:54 (owner says 'go, that one is a flake').

qa_ready.notes: The build is in QA and Harry's 'New version released in QA' post was seen in the QA thread. This is the milestone thread B subscribes to ('tell me when QA is ready'). Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:228-235 (moment 2, subscribe qa_ready) and :278-287 (moment 7).

signoff_requested.notes: Tony asks Harry once, in the QA thread, for sign-off. Audience is the QA thread only because the ask is allowed only there, so this departs from the D3 default. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:289-296 (moment 8) and :425 (rule 26); 23-work/facts-brief.md:55.

prod_alpha_approved.notes: Sign-off received and the prod alpha approval recorded. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:289-296 (moment 8, human go for prod_alpha).

live.notes: The version is live on prod alpha and the served revision was read from the update server. One message per audience thread. Audience: 28-handoff-work-engine-build.md section 3 D3 (request thread, every thread with a promise for live, and the QA thread). Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:298-312 (moments 9 and 10; run 6 posted twice and missed B).

cancel_notice.notes: The owner cancelled and the outcome is known from the live source: stopped before the publish, or the publish had already completed and prod alpha serves the version. One message per audience thread tells that outcome. It is its own milestone so a late cancel is never announced as live (R32).

open_bump_pr.notes: Tony opens the version bump PR with his GitHub token. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:196 and :217-226.

merge_pr.notes: Merge the bump PR into the base branch; takes the main lease. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:257-265 (moment 5). Run 6 also pushed directly to the base branch (:197), which this lease and gate are meant to make visible.

approve_qa_gate.notes: Tony approves the CircleCI job approve-desktop-qa-latest with his own token, after the owner's go. Source: gh-config.yml:118-126; 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:199 and :267-276.

verify_qa.notes: Tony checks that the QA publish job desktop-app-publish-download-page-qa ran for the merged build, and that the QA pipeline matches the merge. Source: gh-config.yml:122-126; 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:267-276 (qa_correlation_mismatch in run 6).

publish_prod_alpha.notes: Tony approves approve-desktop-prod-alpha, which runs desktop-app-publish-download-page-prod-alpha. Takes the alpha lease so two jobs cannot publish to alpha together. Source: gh-config.yml:128-137; 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:298-305 (moment 9).

verify_served.notes: Tony reads what the update server serves on prod alpha and compares it to the version. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:200 and :298-305 (moment 9).

complete_release_issue.notes: Move the release issue (child of ISS-37) to completed. In v8 the Coordinator did this itself; in v3 Tony does it. Source: 22-tony-coordinator-call-map.md:195 and :307-312 (moment 10).
